summary: Frontend-only regression smoke for Phase D (PtFile + Grn reparented onto core.Document with computed stage and gap-free VoucherSeries numbering). All 8 review-request flows verified on the preview URL with zero JS console errors. The computed stage property renders correctly across all four lifecycle stages, FSM-frozen behaviour is enforced in the UI for posted/reversed files, role-aware action visibility (Owner / Warehouse / Accounts) matches the spec, store-cashier scope lock is fail-closed, and a fresh direct GRN was created end-to-end and minted a gap-free voucher (26-27/DEO/GRN/5, immediately after the previously seeded /4).
action_items: No action items. Phase D frontend verification is clean — main agent can proceed to wrap up the remediation.
critical_code_review_comments: PtFile.stage is a derived @property reading docstatus first, falling back to draft_stage — UI badge text and tone correctly track the computed value across mapping/sent/posted/reversed without any extra frontend change. Good split between persisted draft_stage and computed stage.

Posted PtFile detail page correctly hides edit/send/post controls — only Reverse, Export, posted banner, and Stock Ledger link are exposed. This proves the role-aware action gating already keys off the computed stage, not a stored field, so Phase D didn't need parallel frontend work.
GRN doc_number minting via Document FSM post() produces the expected per-series-shard FY/STORE/GRN/N format (verified: 26-27/DEO/GRN/4 -> /5). VoucherSeries gap-free numbering works end-to-end.
test_credentials: owner/Owner@123, wh.patna/Wh@123, accounts1/Acct@123, deo.cashier/Store@123 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md, exposed via demo chips on /login).
seed_data_creation: Created one direct GRN via UI as deo.cashier — vendor 'TEST_PHASED_VENDOR', invoice 'INV-PHASED-001', 2 lines (PHD_STYLE_1 L BLUE PHDBAR-001 qty 3, PHD_STYLE_2 M RED PHDBAR-002 qty 5). Minted doc_number 26-27/DEO/GRN/5 (id 52). This validates the Document FSM post() path in /inbound/grns and is reusable evidence of gap-free numbering.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase D (PtFile/Grn → core.Document FSM with computed PtFile.stage) is verified at the UI layer. Key observations for future regressions: (1) the actual stage_label strings the frontend renders are 'Mapping (Warehouse)' / 'Sent to Patna' / 'Posted to system' / 'Reversed' (not the bare lowercase stage values; backend ptmapper/models.py:_STAGE_LABELS). (2) Seeded PT file IDs at time of run, useful for re-tests without uploading: mapping=81, sent=76, posted=46, reversed=79. (3) GRN doc_number series shard for the DEO store is 'FY/DEO/GRN/N' — next number after this run is /6. (4) Store cashier (deo.cashier) is correctly scope-locked: receive-store-locked is shown, no receive-store-select dropdown, and only DEOstore GRNs appear in the list (35 rows, all DEOstore). (5) Owner-on-posted file exposes only ptfile-reverse + ptfile-posted-banner + ptfile-ledger-link + exports — confirming FSM-frozen UI. (6) Inbound list endpoint is `/inbound/grns` (no trailing slash), as documented in iteration_13.

pt_file_detail_per_stage.fsm_frozen: ptfile-edit, ptfile-send, ptfile-post are absent — verified

rca of the issue: No defects observed. The Phase D backend reparenting (PtFile/Grn → core.Document with computed stage and VoucherSeries-driven doc_number) is fully covered by existing frontend code paths because (a) the serializers still expose 'stage' and 'stage_label' with the same shape and string values that PtMapper.tsx and Inbound.tsx already consume, and (b) the role-aware action gating in the frontend keys off the computed 'stage' string rather than a persisted enum, so a docstatus-derived stage value flows transparently into the badge/stepper/action gating. No frontend changes were required for Phase D, and none of the data-testids broke.
